query: If mixing or consensus diagnostics fail in production runs, which contingency (batch reinitialization, centralized critic, longer critic phase) should be triggered and by what acceptance criteria?

response.query: If mixing or consensus diagnostics fail in production runs, which contingency (batch reinitialization, centralized critic, longer critic phase) should be triggered and by what acceptance criteria?
response.answer: If mixing or consensus diagnostics fail, trigger batch reinitialization. Use acceptance criteria based on error rates below a predefined threshold. Longer critic phase is secondary if reinitialization fails.

results.content: This final rule will revise the Medicare Advantage (Part C), Medicare Prescription Drug Benefit (Part D), Medicare cost plan, and Programs of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE) regulations to implement changes related to Star Ratings, marketing and communications, health equity, provider directories, coverage criteria, prior authorization, passive enrollment, network adequacy, and other programmatic areas. The Advance Notice of Methodological Changes for Calendar Year (CY) 2019 for Medicare Advantage (MA) Capitation Rates, Part C and Part D Payment Policies and 2019 draft Call Letter discusses the clinical trial coverage policy for the MA program on pages 23-23 and is available at this link: *https://www.cms.gov/​Medicare/​Health-Plans/​MedicareAdvtgSpecRateStats/​Downloads/​Advance2019Part2.pdf*. The Announcement of Calendar Year (CY) 2011 Medicare Advantage Capitation Rates and Medicare Advantage and Part D Payment Policies and Final Call Letter addresses this in a response to a comment on page 20-21 and is available at the following link: *https://www.cms.gov/​Medicare/​Health-Plans/​MedicareAdvtgSpecRateStats/​Downloads/​Announcement2011.pdf.*. The annual Medicare Part C & D Star Ratings Technical Notes (available online here: *https://www.cms.gov/​Medicare/​Prescription-Drug-Coverage/​PrescriptionDrugCovGenIn/​PerformanceData*) identify the measures and their data sources for each year's Star Ratings.

results.content: # Mueren al menos siete personas en accidente de autobús en Rusia. MOSCÚ, 3 feb (NNN-TELESUR) — Al menos siete personas fallecieron y 31 resultaron heridos en un accidente de tránsito en el oeste de Rusia. Las autoridades informaron que entre los muertos se encuentran cuatro menores de edad y tres adultos, el accidente tuvo lugar cuando un autobús se volcó en la región rusa de Kaluga, a unos 150 kilómetros al suroeste de Moscú. Desde el hospital local reseñaron que ya han recibido a parte de los afectados, que han sufrido heridas moderadas y se encuentran en estado estable. Al momento del accidente en el autobús se encontraban 48 personas, entre ellas 33 menores. Las autoridades indicaron que aún desconocen las causas del siniestro por lo que sigue bajo investigación.
